# InviteStatus

Where an invite stands.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Unused"` | Sent and not yet accepted: it can still be accepted. |
| `"Cancelled"` | Cancelled by the inviter: it can no longer be accepted. |
| `"Used"` | Accepted. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`Invite`](invite.md)
- Inside [`SendInviteResponse`](send-invite-response.md)
